### What's New in AuraMusic v3.2.1:
- Bit-Perfect Output Scrubber Spacing: Expanded horizontal clearance around the playback quality badge so high-res indicators never collide with elapsed and duration counters.
- Settings Row & Badge Protection: Sub-page headers and setting row titles now use strict proportional weighting and ellipsis handling, keeping status badges and action switches fully visible.
- DAC Pipeline Subtitle Multi-Line Support: Audio output sheet now displays long external DAC model names and stream parameters across multiple lines without truncating mid-word.
- Segmented Multi-Pill Controls: Enhanced horizontal padding and ellipsis clipping for clean text rendering in playback speed and buffer controls.
- Bandwidth Advisory Insets: Added system navigation bar padding to prevent bottom actions from being covered by Android gesture bars.
- Data Usage Dashboard Layouts: Proportional two-tone meter calculation and title collision guards for accurate cellular and Wi-Fi tracking.
- In-Place Upgrade Compatibility: Certified signature alignment ensuring single-tap update without duplicate app entries or data loss.
